canonicalization: For every checklist row, take the six immutable columns in order (ID, requirement, platform, phase, command_or_inspection, expected_result) as they appear between the pipe delimiters of the markdown table row, with escaped pipe sequences (\|) restored to a literal '|' and surrounding whitespace trimmed from each cell; join the six values with a single LF and no trailing whitespace; concatenate all rows in file order, each row's joined string followed by exactly one trailing LF; compute SHA-256 over the resulting UTF-8 byte stream.
